Links use reference-style formatting

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p><a href='https://example.com'>Example</a> and <a href='https://other.com'>Other</a></p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(link_style: 'Reference'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
